name: Container
summary: Centers page content at a max width with a gutter on both inline sides.
useWhen: The content column of a page or a landing section, centered on wide screens
Capping the line length of reading text at a narrow width
Keeping the 16px phone gutter on any page content
avoidWhen: Inside a panel, card or dialog that already has its own padding
Laying out children in a row or columns
A full bleed band of color or media that must reach the screen edges

width.description: The max inline size, gutter included: sm 30rem (breakpoint.phone), md 48rem (breakpoint.tablet), lg 68.75rem (breakpoint.desktop), xl desktop plus half a phone (about 86rem), full no cap. Named width, not size, because size is the shared control axis. Sets data-width.

gutter.description: Padding on both inline sides, a space.* step. 3xl is 16px on phones in the default density. Sets data-gutter.

as.description: The element to render. One main per page.

a11y.role: none of its own: a div, or the landmark of as
a11y.announce: Nothing. A Container is layout only.
notes: Content never scrolls sideways at 320px: the width is a max, the box is 100% and the gutter sits inside it (WCAG 1.4.10).
Width sm keeps reading text near 70 characters a line.

ar.body: No copy of its own. The gutter is the same on both sides, so nothing changes in Arabic.

react.note: No motion: a static layout has nothing to animate, so no pattern from the catalog applies.

angular.note: The host element is the root, so as is not needed.

native.behavior: react-native:View with maxWidth, alignSelf center and paddingHorizontal
native.note: Respect the safe area insets on top of the gutter.

styles.desk: Layout only. Pages sit inside windows, so a Container is mostly for site pages.
styles.liquid: Layout only. Content scrolls under the glass bars; the gutter stays.

mistakes.wrong: A Container inside a Dialog body or a Card
mistakes.right: No Container: the panel already pads its content

mistakes.wrong: max-width 1200px and padding 0 16px written by hand
mistakes.right: Container width lg, which keeps the gutter and the logical margins

mistakes.wrong: size xl to pick a page width
mistakes.right: width xl; size is the control size axis

mistakes.wrong: Two Containers rendered as main on one page
mistakes.right: One main per page; the rest as div or section
